name: system_prompts_leaks
description: Extracted system prompts from Anthropic - Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Claude Design, Claude Code. OpenAI - ChatGPT GPT-6-Astra, Codex. Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly.
one_liner: A running library of the hidden instructions that popular AI chatbots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, and more) are secretly given before you type your first message.
buyer: An AI prompt-engineering consultant or course creator who wants source material to teach clients how leading AI products are actually instructed to behave.
business_use_cases: A prompt-engineering trainer builds a paid course using these leaked prompts as real-world case studies of professional system prompt design.
A competitive-intelligence analyst at an AI startup studies competitors' leaked prompts to understand their guardrails and feature roadmaps.
A journalist or newsletter writer (as already happened with the Washington Post) builds an interactive explainer article sourced from this repo's content.

money_ideas.idea: Publish a paid newsletter or e-book that analyzes and explains the differences between major AI products' system prompts as they evolve.
Build a searchable, well-organized web app on top of the raw files and monetize with ads or a 'pro' tier with alerts on new leaks.

steal_this: Build a simple searchable/diffable web viewer over this repo's files so people can compare how a model's system prompt changed version to version, and put ads or an email capture on it.
